description:
Search claim statements and excerpts.

    A domain keeps claims whose primary domain is that value or one of its
    aliases, such as cs.LG for ai-ml. Hits are ordered by keyword overlap,
    then a domain match, then evidence strength. cross_domain also keeps
    claims from other domains that carry the domain as a secondary tag.
    When the query is one domain keyword and domain is omitted, claims in
    that domain come first.

    Use this when you have keywords or a domain and want the strongest matching claims.
    Returns claim id, status, evidence strength, a shortened excerpt, match_reason,
    source_url, doi, and paper_id when those are known, up to two supporting claims, and one
    contradicting claim when one is stored. Each related claim carries that same compact pointer. unpublished is true for a private unpublished paper. Full provenance stays on get_evidence.
    Example: query_claims(query="transformer", domain="ai-ml", limit=5).
    Example: query_claims(query="United States", domain="data-protection", limit=5).

ClaimFilters.description: Optional status, strength, and assertion type for a claim search.

assertion_type.description: Keep one assertion type: asserted, hedged, or conditional. Example: asserted.

min_strength.description: Drop claims below this evidence strength, from 0 to 1. Example: 0.6.
min_strength.title: Min Strength

status.description: Keep one status: consensus, contested, or outdated. Example: consensus.

ClaimFilters.title: ClaimFilters

cross_domain.description: Also return claims from other primary domains that carry this domain as a secondary tag. Default false.
cross_domain.title: Cross Domain

domain.description: Primary domain or an alias of it. Example: ai-ml.
domain.title: Domain

filters.description: Optional status, minimum evidence strength, and assertion type. Example: {"status": "consensus", "min_strength": 0.6}.

offset.description: Number of hits to skip. Example: 0.
offset.title: Offset

query.description: Text matched against the claim statement and its excerpt. Example: transformer.
query.title: Query

name: query_claims

contradicting.description: One stored contradicting claim, when one is present, with the same compact source pointer.

doi.description: Stored DOI, the DataCite DOI of an arXiv id, or a bioRxiv paper id that is already a DOI. Empty when unknown. Full provenance stays on get_evidence.
doi.title: Doi

match_reason.description: Why this hit ranked here: keyword overlap, domain match, and evidence strength.
match_reason.title: Match Reason

paper_id.description: Stored paper id when one is known. A private paper is an opaque private-paper id. Empty when unknown. Full provenance stays on get_evidence.
paper_id.title: Paper Id

source_url.description: Stable link to the paper when one is known. Empty when the claim has no pointer. Full provenance stays on get_evidence.
source_url.title: Source Url

supporting.description: Up to two other claims from the same papers. Each has claim_id, statement, strength, and the same compact source pointer.
supporting.title: Supporting

unpublished.description: True when this claim is from a private unpublished paper. Public sources stay false.
unpublished.title: Unpublished

RelatedClaim.description: One claim shown beside a search hit.

doi.description: Stored DOI, the DataCite DOI of an arXiv id, or a bioRxiv paper id that is already a DOI. Empty when unknown.
doi.title: Doi

paper_id.title: Paper Id

source_url.title: Source Url

unpublished.title: Unpublished
